[[Krak Flamewhip]] is hot and needs a [[Cold One (item)|Cold One]]. Make [[Ice]] out of [[Frost Golem]]s and use them to turn his [[Warm One]] into a cold one.

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
* [[Summit Slaves]] active in quest log.

===Objectives===
* Lead frost golems through the crushers. Combine enough [[ice]] with the "[[Warm One|warm one]]" to make a "[[Cold One (item)|cold one]]."
* See Krak Flamewhip for your reward.

===Reward===
* 1,500 [[Experience]]

==Walkthrough==
A very straightforward mission. Go to the marker point, and around seven Frost Golems will start to follow you. Walk through a crusher, and stop just outside it. It is best to flag any heroes or henchmen you bring with you away from the crushers so they don't get smashed too. Turn around and watch the golems get crushed into ice. Pick up five pieces of ice, and apply them to a "warm one" to turn it into a "cold one". Speak to Krak Flamewhip for your reward.

[[Elemental]]s ([[Stone Summit]])

:''"It's hot in here, slave. I need a '''cold one.''' Fetch me one, and make it cold. Got it?"''

===Reward dialogue===
;Krak Flamewhip
:''"Ah...that hits the spot. Next time, bring me an even colder one!"''

==Notes==
* The Gap can be scouted for [[Summit Slaves]] while making ice.
* There is a lot of iron ore in this area, for the [[Gathering Resources]] quest.
* It is possible to leave this quest uncompleted, instead focusing on your other quests, this gives you as many as 10 powerful allies, which is very useful for some of the other quests from Krak Flamewhip.
* The Crushers seem to only kill you and the Frost Golems, but do not give any Death Penalty.
* Should you delete the Warm One, Krak won't give you a new one.

==Trivia==
*A "cold one" is common slang for a beer.
**The specific wording of "one that's cold" and referring to a "room temperature [one]" make this a likely reference to the [[w:Homestar Runner|Homestar Runner]] cartoon, ''property of ones''.
